policy: Vanilla stable blocks are the default. No live-functional/machine block may be placed as structure set dressing unless it has an explicit, structure-scoped exception in approved-functional-block-exceptions.json; the required default is a vanilla proxy or, where one exists, an infinite_domain:ruined_* decorative equivalent. Modded directional, connective, kinetic, fluid and block-entity blocks otherwise require an explicit purpose and verified state.
